remarks: Welcome to your newly renovated home at Fountain Terrace! This gorgeous two-bedroom unit showcases an updated kitchen with quartz countertops, a stylish tile backsplash, and Stainless Steel Samsung appliances. Natural light pours into the spacious living room, highlighting the brand-new engineered wood flooring. Step out from the living room onto your private balcony to take in stunning city skyline views, or head downstairs to enjoy the in-ground pool and fitness center. The serene primary bedroom offers a generous closet and its own beautiful city view, while the versatile second bedroom is perfect for guests, a home office, or a nursery. Heat, hot water, water, and sewer are all included in the HOA fees. The unit also comes with one storage unit and one assigned parking space. You'll love the blend of style, comfort, and convenience this condominium offers-schedule your showing today!
